### Global Metadata
A complete 90-second cozy indoor piece for browsing a small old-fashioned neighbourhood general store and a family bakery, warm and friendly like a cafe. 96 BPM, G major. Upright piano with a light swing, brushed snare, upright bass, a soft vibraphone, an accordion colour. Pure instrumental ensemble piece.

### Vocal Details
None. Instrumental only: piano and vibraphone play a friendly tune with a light swing.

### Timed Arrangement
0-12 seconds: piano and brushes set a gentle swing. 12-44 seconds: the piano tune with bass. 44-70 seconds: vibraphone and accordion take the melody. 70-90 seconds: piano returns, cozy. Keep tempo, texture and loudness consistent from start to end; no big climax. The piece must play for the full 90 seconds and must not end early, ending cleanly on the tonic so it can loop.
